description: Fork of exp573 (separate LN_emb, killed at step 200 = 4.2146 ~ exp572's 4.1936; CE = log(V) again). SINGLE change vs exp573: initialize ln_emb.weight (gamma_emb) to 0.1 instead of 1.0. Diagnosis from exp572/573: CE = log(V) at step 200 was NOT gamma collapse — it was the OPPOSITE failure mode (logits with std ~sqrt(E)*gamma=~10 making softmax peak CONFIDENTLY on RANDOM wrong vocab, average CE = log(V) for random peaks). Fix: smaller gamma_emb init brings logit scale to ~1.0 at step 0, softer softmax, model can learn signal instead of fighting random-direction peaks. gamma_emb stays LEARNABLE — can grow if optimizer wants higher temperature later. Predicted step 200 closer to exp571's 2.81 or lower. exp571 trajectory (no LN_emb at all) was 200/800/1000/2000 = 2.81/1.98/1.91/1.78; exp572/573 both stuck near 4.19 at step 200. If exp574 starts at ~2.5-2.8 and descends as exp571 did, the diagnosis is confirmed; if at ~4.19 again, deeper issue. Refs: exp567 1.4768 (full-stream parent), exp571 (no LN_emb) killed at step 2000.
